# Library loan

## State machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    Requested
    OnLoan
    Overdue
    Returned
    Cancelled
    [*] --> Requested
    Requested --> Cancelled : Cancel [role = Member] / Audit:LoanCancelled
    Requested --> OnLoan : CheckOut [role = Librarian and assigned] / Audit:LoanCheckedOut, Notification:MemberNotified
    OnLoan --> Overdue : MarkOverdue [role = Clerk] / Audit:LoanOverdue, Notification:OverdueNoticeQueued
    OnLoan --> Returned : Return [role = Librarian] / Audit:LoanReturned
    Overdue --> Returned : ReturnLate [role = Librarian] / Audit:LoanReturnedLate
    Returned --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]
```
